create_recorder_from_agent: create a Recorder instance from an agent to track Minecraft world state changes
load_recorder_from_file: load a Recorder from a pickled file to restore previously recorded world state
record_world_state: record the current world state including mobs, players, agent, and block changes
replay_recorded_steps: iterate through recorded tape entries to replay world state step by step
save_recorder_to_file: save the Recorder tape and world state to a pickled file for later use
